data.name: 挽天：汉末（BRUTAL WAR : The Fall of Great Han）
data.detailed_description:
Rescue the Chinese Nation in Peril
Return to the most tumultuous eras in Chinese history and assume the role of a renowned military leader of the time. Employ military, political, and economic strategies to unite various forces, restore order and peace across the vast and magnificent land of China within your character’s lifetime, and potentially lay the foundation for the next great era. You will have the opportunity to convincingly reshape Chinese history according to your own vision!

An unprecedented open-world, fully real-time strategic gaming experience
Combat, construction, diplomacy—every activity unfolds in real-time across a massive open world. Players will immerse themselves from the perspective of a real general, experiencing a dynamically changing environment with shifting seasons, weather, and day-night cycles. Without the need for tedious and repetitive micromanagement, you can effortlessly command your massive armies to conquer all directions.

Cutting-edge AI decision-making algorithms and deeply authentic gameplay deliver challenge without sacrificing fun
Every entity in the game, whether ally or enemy, possesses independent thinking and decision-making capabilities. Powered by intelligent algorithms designed for realistic strategic interactions, their behavior closely mirrors that of human societies in the real world. This makes the game’s development complex, chaotic, and highly unpredictable, delivering a level of challenge akin to real-world political and military struggles.

data.short_description: An innovative open-world real-time strategy game where you become a political-military leader in ancient China. Command legions, build strongholds, and manage operations across a dynamically evolving landscape. Compete against intelligent AI in an epic struggle to reshape Chinese history .
